Rooted in Hudson

The Hudson
Story.

Hudson deserved a place that could hold all of it — the dinner crowd, the music crowd, the late-night crowd, the people celebrating something real.

Max's Social House was built for this city. Not as a stopover on the way to the Twin Cities, but as a destination in its own right. Five spaces, one address, and an honest belief that the best nights are the ones that surprise you.
